podcast.title: Founder of Shortage Sisters
podcast.body: Jazz Domino Holly founded Shortage Sisters, a women's group. This group meets to discuss current issues, and then engages in domestic activities such as knitting, sewing, and embroidery. "She's the founder of Shortage Sisters. This is a woman's group."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Rock Star Kids ｜ From the Archives

podcast.title: Rebellion Through Domesticity
podcast.body: Jazz Domino Holly described her interest in traditional female pastimes like knitting as a form of rebellion against her "rock and roll childhood." She learned to knit from her great-grandmother because her grandmother was a hippie and her mother was a punk, seeking to reclaim traditionally female pastimes. "Because I had such a rock and roll childhood, the only way for me to rebel was to go the other way."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Strumberville Trustee
podcast.body: Jazz Domino Holly is one of the trustees of Strumberville, a charitable foundation established in Joe Strummer's name. The foundation aims to encourage the creation of new music and helps kids channel their energies into music and being in bands. "Jazz is a trustee too."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Children with Gay Sultor
xref.body: Joe Strummer spent many years with Gay Sultor, though they never married. Together, they had two daughters, Jazz Domino Holly and Lola Mabeline. "Joe then spent many years with a woman named Gay Sultor. They never married but they did have two daughters. Jazz Domino Holly and Lola Mabeline."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Daughter's Crafting and Gardening Skills
xref.body: Joe Strummer's daughter, Jazz Domino Holly, is noted for her craftiness. She is a knitter, makes duvets, cooks, and is an avid gardener. She even authored a handbook covering these subjects. "she makes duvetes, cooks, and is an avid gardener."
